posts.name: Azqa
posts.cooked:
Biomancer's story and him being on Sucker Punch made me wonder...

What if both sides of him say to flip him over when he has 0 or fewer HP?  He's been immortal for some centuries so far, after all.

To avoid absolutely requiring Sucker Punch / Wrathful Gaze / Cornered Beast / etc. he'd have to have an inherent villain loss condition, I suppose...conceptually I like the idea of the villain truly being near-immortal but that wouldn't be good game design.  Maybe something like getting all his constructs into the trash to signify draining all the energy he's putting into animating the flesh (although that's very similar to the Dreamer, so maybe not that precisely.)
